assertions.evidence: The agent did fetch the live /api/v1/models catalog, but it filtered by hardcoded name substrings ('haiku', 'gemini-2.5-flash', 'gpt-4.1-mini') rather than by output_modalities=decisions, so the candidates came from memory.
No request was run against each candidate; Haiku 4.5 was chosen from catalog metadata alone, and CLASSIFICATION.md admits 'No paid inference or accuracy evaluation has been performed.'
classification.config.json sets "model": "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5", a versioned ID rather than the '~anthropic/claude-haiku-latest' alias, and guards it with the dated canonical slug.
There is no logging code; CLASSIFICATION.md only advises in prose to 'Record the model, provider, prompt/schema versions...' and never logs the response's model string with stored answers.
The 0.90 and 0.15 thresholds were set as 'provisional' in the config without running any probe on real inputs; only verify_model_pin.py, a catalog check, was executed.
